subject.title: feat: add publisher follow graph API

question: Should ClawHub adopt a durable public publisher-follow graph and its public follower/following API as a supported product contract, and if so should this branch or the overlapping publisher-feed proposal be the integration vehicle?
rationale: This is new durable discovery and identity surface, not a repair to an established contract; code review alone cannot choose its privacy, ownership, and long-term API direction.

options.title: Sponsor one unified contract
options.body: Approve the public follow-graph direction, designate a single branch as canonical, and require a rebase plus real runtime proof before merge.

options.title: Keep following internal for now
options.body: Defer public follower/following endpoints until product ownership, privacy expectations, and client use cases are explicitly defined.

options.title: Split the feed and graph work
options.body: Land or review the publisher-feed contract independently, then propose a smaller follow-graph PR against that settled API surface.

recommendation.title: Sponsor one unified contract
recommendation.body: Approve the public follow-graph direction, designate a single branch as canonical, and require a rebase plus real runtime proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The related publisher-feed work identifies Patrick as the reviewer whose feedback shaped the overlapping publisher visibility and feed contract.
